89:96.en: 「This is as far as you go!」

89:600.en: 「Like hell I'll let that hit me!」

89:810.en: 「Time to show them what I can do!」

89:890.en: 「I know I can surpass the Colonel!」

89:1125.en: 「I'll be a man worthy of $$クェス$$!」

89:1199.en: 「I never thought I'd pilot a Gundam!」

89:1289.en: 「I've already got you in my sights!」

89:1618.en: 「Still in my way, $$ロンド・ベル$$?!」

89:1659.en: 「This is as far as you go, Gundam!」

89:1766.en: 「If I kill the $$一年戦争$$ hero...!」

89:1805.en: 「So the Colonel took a shine to you!」

89:2091.en: 「I won't lose to puppets\ndancing for $$フロンタル$$...!」

89:2192.en: 「I already know how you people work!」

89:2233.en: 「I watched you up close!\nI know your habits!」

89:2450.en: 「In the end you're just like\nthe Colonel, an egoist!」

89:2540.en: 「I've finally made it this far!\nWatch me, $$クェス$$...!」

89:2597.en: 「You've had your way long enough!\nIt ends right here!」

89:2773.en: 「I'll throw them off with the Beam!」

89:2891.en: 「Do I really have to use this thing?!」

89:3115.en: 「I'll strike when your guard is down!」

89:3283.en: 「I won't lose to you of all people!」

89:3374.en: 「Don't worry! This is my mission too!」

89:3627.en: 「I just need to take that one out...!」

89:3660.en: 「I'll see if you're a worthy foe!」

89:3703.en: 「I need to live up to expectations!」

89:3855.en: 「I'll wipe you all out at once!」

89:3958.en: 「I have to let them get away?!」

89:4167.en: 「I cost them a fortune, you know!」

89:4348.en: 「That won't do a thing to me!」

89:4373.en: 「The Funnel can even form a barrier.」

89:4410.en: 「Is that the best you can do?!」

89:4526.en: 「Don't cheer just because you hit me!」

89:4648.en: 「They only hit part of my monitor!」

89:4821.en: 「So this is $$アムロ・レイ$$'s power!」

89:4922.en: 「As long as it moves, that's enough!」

89:5058.en: 「Think! There must still be a way...!」

89:5144.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

89:5294.en: 「If you hear this, you recruited me.」

89:5353.en: 「Then I have a favor to ask you.」

89:5386.en: 「For $$クェス$$ too, I must prove I top the Colonel and $$アムロ$$.」

89:5467.en: 「Not just them. I can't lose to $$カミーユ$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$ガロード$$, $$ロラン$$, $$キラ$$, $$シン$$, $$刹那$$ or $$バナージ$$ either!」

89:5592.en: 「So use me. I'm counting on you!」
